bibliographic.title: Guests are Coming!
bibliographic.author: theonedari
bibliographic.description:
Mehmaan Aa rahae Hain!
The Guests are Coming!

In this game, you have 4 and a half minutes to shop through your Mom's grocery list!

But it's not that simple.

This game tests your patience in waiting at the worst possible moments, and also to an extent your the pace at which you can read Roman Urdu (Though translation is easily available by hovering over sentences.)

Essentially you need to manage your time effectively through the chaos of the streets of Karachi.

Multiple Branches!

Multiple Endings!

Random encounters with the chance of getting pick pocketed by a random dude on a 70cc!
